The only change is && (!sc.wkwNot || !itemHasKw(it, sc.wkwNot)). itemHasKw is the same keyword test as wkw (exact, or 'KW ' prefix: 'SUSTAINED HITS' matches 'SUSTAINED HITS 1') over every profile of the item. It matches GW's '(excluding Extra Attacks weapons)': a weapon with that keyword is excluded. evidence G5 holds wkwNot to the quote's own '(excluding … weapons)', and coverage LC requires wkwNot or the words quoted.
